_source: CBP ruling N308174 (2 Jan 2020): polypropylene dividers cut, scored and pre-folded in China, then folded, heat-sealed, punched and packed in Mexico: CBP held China. In the D580 selection pool (Part 102, dated before 2024, in no development or held-out split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.

product.name: Insertable plastic dividers, set of five
product.description: Tabbed polypropylene dividers with pockets, packed in sets of five for notebooks and binders.

components.name: pre-cut and scored polypropylene divider sheets

operations.name: cut the plastic sheets to size, score the fold line and pre-cut the tabs
fold, heat-seal, punch three holes and pack sets of five
